headline: Tight Liquidity, Debt Rating of Buma (DOID) Subsidiary Plunges
summary: PEFINDO downgraded the credit rating of PT Bukit Makmur Mandiri Utama (BOLD), a subsidiary of PT BUMA Internasional Group (DOID). The move was linked to tight liquidity, according to the headline.
why: Credit rating downgrades raise borrowing costs for a company and its affiliates, and Buma is an Indonesian coal mining group.
original_headline: Likuiditas Ketat, Peringkat Utang Anak Usaha Buma (DOID) Anjlok
